headline: Stonecradle Swings Back as Fisherman's Row Flares Anew
war_summary: Three hours on from our last edition, the night has brought fresh reversals. Stonecradle, which stood six Warden works to three at the previous writing, has turned again — six Colonial holdings to three now stand, with five actions in the past two hours and the latest at the wire. Fisherman's Row is the liveliest corner of the map: six exchanges inside two hours, casualties climbing at an accelerating rate, and a five-to-four Colonial edge among its nine works. Godcrofts and the Linn of Mercy each logged events as this edition went to press, the former split four works apiece, the latter standing nine Colonial to one Warden, both with a holding in ruin. The Weathered Expanse, busiest of all over the day with fifty-nine actions, has fallen silent these two hours, as has Stlican Shelf after fifty, its seven Warden works to two Colonial unmoved. Callahan's Passage shows no change of ownership since late morning, though the day's toll there tops 8,900 Colonial and 7,000 Warden. The ledger now reads 284 Colonial works to 150 Warden, two in ruin, upon the war's two-hundred-and-twenty-fourth day.
